title.narrative: Strengthening Ethical AI Governance in East Asia

description.narrative:
This workplan will support ethical and human rights-based AI governance in East Asia, with a focus on strengthening policy dialogue, institutional capacity and stakeholder engagement around UNESCO’s Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence.
The work will support national and regional engagement on AI ethics, including policy dialogue, capacity-building, knowledge exchange and practical recommendations on responsible AI governance. It will address issues such as human rights, gender equality, transparency, accountability, inclusion, sustainability, data governance, public-sector AI use, and AI impacts on young people and vulnerable groups.
In Mongolia, UNESCO will support a national capacity-building and policy dialogue on ethical AI governance with government institutions, digital governance actors, academia, youth and civil society. In China, UNESCO will explore cooperation with academic, policy and technology partners on AI ethics, inclusive AI, gender-responsive AI and responsible innovation. Regional knowledge-sharing may be explored where relevant to connect experiences and technical expertise across countries covered by the Beijing Office.
